name: Synthetic Turf Fields
description: This dataset lists synthetic turf installations maintained by the New York City Department of Parks and Recreation, covering 338 records across the five boroughs. Each row describes a single turf system, identified by a system code and parent ID, with a description and location field naming the park, playground, or field where it sits. Records indicate whether the installation is a field group, play area, or dog run, and whether the turf uses infill or is non-infill. For infill systems, the infill material is recorded (for example coated sand, uncoated sand, rubber crumb, or crumb rubber). Additional fields capture who maintains the site (mostly DPR, with some outside organizations named), who built it, contract type and number, and the commission date. Borough is given as a single-letter code (M, B, Q, X, R), and a feature status field marks each record as active, removed, archived, inactive, or pending; all sampled records show retired
